claim: When a lane dies, audit the REMOTE PUSH STATE FIRST — before touching local clones; one curl sorts the death into already-landed / staged-work / died-early.
evidence: wave-68 lost 3 of 6 lanes to result-return deadlines; remote-first triage: 68-e had already pushed and worklogged (folded from its own pushed state, no finisher needed), 68-a/68-b had pushed nothing but left well-shaped staged work (facts.js modules, ed25519.mjs) — two finishers recovered everything with zero work lost
why: the push state, not the worklog, is the ground truth of what a dead lane actually did

pins.name: one branches-list call sorts any death
pins.how: wave-68 triage receipts; this agent sorted its own pre-flight the same way before seeding
